piezas.titulo: Reading comprehension: Reports, data and synthesis
texto: Contextual reading of the conclusions and limitations section of a social research report: read how the researchers present their quantitative data. Notice the balance with which measured progress is highlighted against uncontrolled variables and the need for longer time series.

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «รายงานวิจัยควรระบุข้อจำกัดของระเบียบวิธีวิจัยเพื่อความโปร่งใสทางวิชาการ» express?

opciones.texto: Technical reports must declare the methodological limitations of the research with rigour.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «รายงานวิจัยควรระบุข้อจำกัดของระเบียบวิธีวิจัยเพื่อความโปร่งใสทางวิชาการ» from the text.

opciones.texto: Combining quantitative and qualitative data offers a deep and well-rounded picture.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another complementary statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: The final recommendations should be practical and in line with the budget.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: Read the sentence and choose its meaning.
